paragraphs.text:
You swing at Joshua. You manage to land a few solid blows 
but you get as good as you give, with him hitting you several 
times as well. It seems like this brawl could go on for some time 
before a winner is decided.

Unfortunately for you, time is not on your side. As you 
continue to strike out against Joshua, the door of the house 
bursts open and the other man charges you. Together, he and 
Joshua beat you into unconsciousness.
